Let $X$ be a scheme. The following are equivalent:
\begin{enumerate}
\item $X$ is a G-scheme,
\item $X$ is locally Noetherian and for all $x \in X$ the ring
map $\mathcal{O}_{X, x} \to \mathcal{O}_{X, x}^\wedge$ is regular, and
\item $X$ is locally Noetherian and for any closed point $x \in X$
the ring map $\mathcal{O}_{X, x} \to \mathcal{O}_{X, x}^\wedge$ is regular.
\end{enumerate}

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-locally-G-scheme}
Let $X$ be a scheme. The following are equivalent:
\begin{enumerate}
\item The scheme $X$ is a G-scheme.
\item For every affine open $U \subset X$ the ring $\mathcal{O}_X(U)$
is a G-ring.
\item There exists an affine open covering $X = \bigcup U_i$ such that
each $\mathcal{O}_X(U_i)$ is a G-ring.
\item There exists an open covering $X = \bigcup X_j$
such that each open subscheme $X_j$ is a G-scheme.
\end{enumerate}
Moreover, if $X$ is a G-scheme then every open subscheme is a
G-scheme.
